title: Vakuu's Agentic Auditor
description: An offline coach for solo Slay the Spire 2 public-beta runs. Ask Vakuu about your hand, a reward, or the next fork. Click a suggestion to dismiss it or drag it to a favorite spot for that screen. Press V to ask again. Settings → General → Vakuu’s Agentic Auditor controls what you hear. Targets beta v0.113.1; no dependencies.
changeNote: Optional Curse Mode: Vakuu sometimes twists or withholds advice with a snarky remark. Odds rise with Ascension. Off by default; enable it at the top of Auditor settings.
